capabilities: Export selected plugins and themes to a JSON profile file
Import a profile file and bulk-install the listed plugins and themes
Skip already-installed plugins and themes during reinstall
Reapply the active theme after reinstallation
Uninstall selected plugins and themes from the vault
disambiguation: Not a vault backup or file-recovery tool; it only reinstalls plugins and themes from an exported list.
extras: Desktop only (needs file system API access) and requires Obsidian 1.4.0 or higher; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: without relying on manual searches in the built-in community store
problem: Obsidian's built-in community store requires manually searching for and installing each plugin and theme one by one when setting up a new vault or machine.
summary: Plugin manager that exports your installed community plugins and themes to a JSON profile and bulk-reinstalls them in other vaults.
